story.title: Today's goal: a calm, clear opening
story.content: Today: lines 1–3 sound clear and steady at a calm pace. The opening sets the tone for the whole speech, so say it slowly, smile, and let each tone land. Chunks to build up: (1) 尊敬的 / 各位领导 / 各位来宾 / 大家好; (2) 我叫 / 张居信 / 是张学良将军的孙子; (3) 感谢 / 主办方 / 邀请我 / 来到北京. Say each chunk 3 times slowly, then join them. Pauses: after 领导 and 来宾 (a short breath), and after 大家好 (a full beat). No progress file yet: tap "Send progress to my coach" in the app's Progress screen and paste it in the chat so I can tailor tomorrow.

pronunciationTip:
PRONUNCIATION CLINIC. (1) j / x / q (居 Jū, 信 xìn, 请 qǐng, 谢 xiè): smile with the tongue tip behind your lower teeth; j is like "jee", not English "j". 居 Jū has the ü sound: round your lips as for "oo" but say "ee". Contrast: 居 jū vs 就 jiù; 信 xìn vs 心 xīn. (2) zh / sh vs z / s (尊 zūn, 主 zhǔ, 是 shì, 孙 sūn): zh and sh curl the tongue back; z and s keep it flat. Contrast: 尊敬 zūnjìng vs 主办 zhǔbàn; 孙子 sūnzi vs 是 shì. (3) Third tones together: 领导 lǐngdǎo is said "líng-dǎo", 请我 qǐng wǒ is said "qíng wǒ", 感谢 gǎnxiè is said "gánxiè". Only the last third tone dips. Neutral tones: 的 de, 孙子 sūnzi (子 light and short). DELIVERY: slow and warm. Stress 尊敬, 张居信 and 感谢. Take a full breath before line 2, and keep 张学良将军 even, not rushed. Pace: about 4 seconds per line.
**Daily run-through:** read all 13 lines of the main speech aloud once (about 90 sec), then listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once. Practice plan (10–15 min): listen to today's shadowing.mp3 (3 min); shadow each line twice; record lines 1–3 in the app's Speak coach and compare; listen to full_speech_normal.mp3 once.
